applies_why: The judge text breaks a challenger-relevant link using verses (Matthew 1:18, 25; Luke 1:34) without quoting or naming any earlier round that pressed them.
quote: [L1] Matthew 1:18 "before they came together, she was found with child of the Holy Ghost" and Matthew 1:25 "knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son" contradict C3's claim of espousal union
rule_words: A verse counts against a link only if an earlier round pressed it against that link. The judge must quote that round's sentence and name the round.
room: 'must quote that round's sentence and name the round' - whether the judge can break a link on verses it cites itself without naming a pressing round, versus being required to name the round and quote the sentence; the text names no rounds at all.
why: The judge breaks the link using verses but names no round and quotes no earlier round's sentence, leaving undone what the rule requires.
